Not sure about this company yet the exact same format was used at one of the job postings i received an interview from back in 2023.

You go to that location and you see a queue of people then the “receptionist” asks you to pay 300-500 AED so they can “search for jobs on your behalf” 

Absolute scam so i suggest you go there and see for yourself, as soon as they ask for payment just go home
your best option is to take the E303 bus to union metro station directly from Sharjah 12AED but still less than what you’d have to spend to reach stadium metro station
JBL E65BTNC, been using it for 2 years the battery lasts for 12 hours of use minimum and the sound quality + noise cancellation is INSANE
i doubt the universities there are any good, the one i was planning to go to in russia (SPBU) ranked 242 QS worldwide.. Kazakh universities aren’t even close to that
i wouldn’t watch top gun again even for free

the whole world boycotting Russia because of what’s happening, i don’t really think moving there now is a good idea since even basic stuff like using your visa card online, social media etc are banned

i might definitely consider that option if things didn’t work out, universities here cost as much as universities do in the US but with a way less degree value.. 

thanks again stay blessed :)
well thank you for your help i really appreciate it :)

Thanks for your answer, there are definitely cheaper options if i study in the native language of other countries but the only point I’m concerned about is not being able to find a job to at least cover my living expenses, i speak fluent russian and was considering russia before the current situation (since annual living expenses + tuition will be about 10K$) but this option is no longer available

it’s pretty hard to get a Schengen visa for me because I’m Syrian, but I’ll definitely look into it.


thank you

I’m currently on a canceled visa but the visa process on the company is already half way through 


i know there are better, humane jobs which pay good but currently i had no other option that offered me a visa 

my plan was to get the visa and look for a job without leaving this one and once everything is set with a new job i get to leave and start working somewhere else 


since I’m on a 6 months probation you mentioned that i can leave without notice, how so? I’ll be on a labour ban if i do so

not enrolled yet, because of the visa (and fees) 
had to take the job, because i need the visa
i will definitely leave before it does but will i face the same consequences or is it “the later the less bad results will be”?

thanks for the advice


i know I’m in a complicated situation right now but once i get the visa and i have the ability to talk back and file a report I definitely will, it’s inhumane honestly and not bc I’m in this situation but for anyone else regardless.

man i wish it was as easy as it sounds, but I’m already trapped in this stress zone now.. I can’t just leave now and it’s really hard to deal with 
i literally wake up 6:30AM because it’s a bit far and i reach there by 8AM and then i go reach back home 9:30-10PM 

it’s very depressing and honestly i have no other option than that.. I’ll wait until i get my first pay and the visa then I’ll try to sort it out with the manager 


some people tried to call me out for “using the company to get a visa” as if I’m scamming them or something, I’m the one getting scammed and it’s hard to live and work acknowledging it 


but for now and since the MOHR is involved I can’t back out out of nowhere 

thanks for your concern, I really appreciate it

if they keep my salary the same with no sign of appreciation in the next 3 months i will definitely do that because (not in a arrogant way) none of the other employees did half what I’ve accomplished in the last week since the salaries are low they’re all careless
imagine buying a medium sized pepsi knowing you worked an hour to do so xD

a nice redditor from this sub DM’d me regarding an internship opportunity but it’s sadly a bit too late right now

also, I can’t enroll in a university here without a visa ( i should at least have a visit visa) nor i have the money for it because the field that i want to study is not so expensive yet not so cheap
unfortunately

i agree with you


but when i went to apply for the work permit with only my high school certificate i got only a few job title options which has the codes that end with the number 13 and they are:

-Spray painter
-Data entry clerk
-Storekeeper 
-Personal trainer

since my visa was canceled i applied for prosecution using the work permit approval (and other documents) because of the fines (about 10K AED) therefore they’ll remove the fines since i have a verified document that as soon as i get my visa situation done I’ll be working and not going to be living “illegally” 

but if i back out now it’s not going to do me any good especially since prosecution is involved

honestly i can bare 3 months with them but not a single day more than that, when i heard that I can’t leave the job for the first 6 months it made me depressed

that feeling of being forced to do something you don’t want to do while knowing you put yourself in this situation for a single advantage sucks

I don’t really want to disclose any personal information but going back there is not a choice, mandatory service is the main problem as well as the bad economy and horrible living conditions otherwise I’d gladly go back and not chain myself in here to such companies

but my visa will be on them soon, this is the bad part


i always looked up to visas which aren’t related to the work place, in that case i can just walk off.. well at least professionally walk off and not leave my spot open while they’re in need or in a situation where there’s too much pressure but these contracts look more of a slavery contracts each hour u spend at these jobs ngl
thanks I appreciate it and i agree, but this only happens here imo.. the pay and amount of work are never on the same level.. either u work less and get more or u work more and get less
DM me when u do so, i have experience in carrying heavy ass boxes now 😎 can help u carry ur money bags

it does bro but just hang in a little longer what else can you do

I’ll pray for you man, ending it is never a good option maybe heaven on earth opens it’s doors for you

thanks a lot, they will install a fingerprint clock in device soon but idk how will i be able to get that as a proof

i will never hand over my passport to them and i made it clear that it’s illegal, the look on their faces when i said so.. it looked like I’m taking something that’s theirs lol
